highlights.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
highlights.authors: Guangyi Liu, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
highlights.why: Open-source personal agent with persistent memory across devices is a significant release and the most-upvoted paper of the day.
highlights.key_result: The paper presents nanoMuse, a minimal, complete open-source personal agent under the GPL-3.0 (Android, iOS, desktop, web apps plus the relay), first released on September 25, 2026, described as of version 0.1.40 (October 2026).
evidence: nanoMuse is a minimal, complete personal agent under the GPL-3.0: an Android app, an iOS app (TestFlight), a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, a web app, and the relay, nanoMuse Cloud, with its console. The first release was on September 25, 2026; this report describes the code as of version 0.1.40 (October 2026).

Against Muse , nanoMuse adds hands on the Android phone's screen; the phone and the computer are operated on the device itself, not in a VM; every part is open, the relay included; and the model is the person's choice.

highlights.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
highlights.authors: Xin Wang, Hao Yu, Zhengyang Zhuge et al.
highlights.why: TRACE uses rollout-guided quantization for FP4 RL of MoE models, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy with practical efficiency gains.
highlights.key_result: We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4 rollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

highlights.title: From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail
highlights.authors: Hongzhan Lin, Shidong Cao, Ziyang Luo et al.
highlights.why: Empirically identifies where tool-using agents fail between evidence and action, providing a benchmark and deterministic evaluator.
highlights.key_result: Across ten model--harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution: failures often begin before execution, with agents stopping after incomplete investigation or acting before required evidence is established, while single-action execution is usually reliable once required evidence is obtained and multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution.
evidence: Across ten model--harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution.
GLM--ZCode and DeepSeek--DSH both exceed 96% on Legacy, yet they differ sharply on V1--V3: DeepSeek--DSH remains around 60%, whereas GLM--ZCode falls to between 12.1% and 34.1%.

Conditional on an action attempt after evidence completion, CAS ranges from 93.2% to 100% for nine of the ten configurations, with DeepSeek--Inspect lower at 83.3%. Investigation and action timing are therefore important upstream sources of failure, whereas single-action execution after evidence completion remains generally reliable.

highlights.title: DecepEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Deception in LLM Agents
highlights.authors: Yiming Xu, Hongyue Yu, Beihua Yang et al.
highlights.why: Introduces a systematic benchmark for deception in LLM agents across conditions, revealing inducements increase deception even in low-baseline models.
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces DecepEval, a benchmark comprising 1,532 instances across 3 task families and 28 professional scenarios, and reports that evaluations of nine frontier LLMs show inducements increase deception across all evaluated models and task families, with long-horizon interactions exhibiting the highest rates, increasing by 55.73%.
evidence: To address this gap, we introduce DecepEval, a benchmark comprising 1,532 instances across 3 task families and 28 professional scenarios. Drawing on classical fraud theories, we propose the LLM Deception Diamond framework, which characterizes four external conditions that may induce deception: pressure, incentive, opportunity, and conflict.

Evaluations of nine frontier LLMs show that inducements increase deception across models and task families, even among models with low baseline deception rates. DecepEval makes these vulnerabilities measurable, providing a shared benchmark for progress toward trustworthy artificial intelligence.

Inducements increase deception across all evaluated models and task families, with long-horizon interactions exhibiting the highest rates, increasing by 55.73%. Under induced conditions, deception is more prevalent in medical, legal, and financial scenarios and less frequent in software engineering tasks with executable checks.

highlights.title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
highlights.authors: Yifan Zhang, Jichen Feng, Shihan Qin
highlights.why: Recurrent Looped Transformer introduces recurrent decoder for length generalization, showing dramatic improvements on algorithmic tasks.
highlights.key_result: Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance; on swap-based S_5 permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth; on modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based S_5 to chance at every split.

highlights.title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
highlights.authors: Edan Kinderman, Elad Hoffer, Yochai Blau et al.
highlights.why: Shows a single model-internal mechanism can select evidence across retrieval and long-context, with strong gains and minimal parameters.
highlights.key_result: UNREAL, a model-native evidence selection framework that adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged, lets all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems on a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index: the best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue, while applied to long-context tasks the same mechanism raises NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at 128K tokens and LV-Eval's F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K.
evidence: We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue.

Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mechanism removes distractors before generation, raising NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at its maximum context length of 128K tokens, and LV-Eval’s F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K. UNREAL also reduces FLOPs and time-to-first-token relative to full-context inference from roughly 32K tokens onward, with larger gains as context grows. Together, these results establish model-internal evidence selection as a common foundation for corpus retrieval and evidence-sparse long-context inference.

news.title: How DOCA GPUNetIO Unifies GPU-Initiated Networking Across the NVIDIA Software Stack
news.summary: NVIDIA describes DOCA GPUNetIO as a unified GDA-KI foundation that lets CUDA kernels drive Ethernet, RDMA, Verbs, and DMA operations with the CPU off the critical path, shipping as both a DOCA SDK superset and a lighter open-source Verbs-focused implementation. It reports NCCL GIN integrating the open-source GPUNetIO Verbs path since version 2.27, NVSHMEM 3.7 adding a GPUNetIO-based transport, and NVQLink achieving approximately 2.6 microseconds minimum round-trip latency on IGX Thor with a Blackwell GPU and ConnectX-7.

news.title: AICR v1.0: Open, stable, and verifiable GPU cluster configuration
news.summary: NVIDIA released AICR v1.0, which provides version-locked, validated recipes for GPU-accelerated Kubernetes clusters and establishes a stable compatibility contract across the CLI, REST API, Go SDK, bundle layout, and artifact schemas. The four capabilities are Snapshot, Recipe, Bundle, and Validation; AICR has over 100 distinct contributors, almost half from outside NVIDIA, with integrations from Pulumi Labs and Mirantis's k0rdent.

news.title: Control How Your GPU Shares Work with Green Contexts
news.summary: Green contexts in CUDA 13.1 let applications explicitly partition GPU execution resources such as SMs and workqueues within a single process, following their availability in the Driver API since CUDA 12.4. NVIDIA reports an example reducing critical kernel latency from 0.140 ms to 0.007 ms on a Blackwell GPU with 148 SMs; the feature is opt-in and additive.

news.title: Building a context-aware AI assistant on AgentCore and OpenClaw
news.summary: AWS describes building a context-aware gardening assistant called Sprout on AgentCore runtime with the open source agentic system OpenClaw and AgentCore memory, using Claude Haiku 4.5 for text and Claude Sonnet 4.5 for vision, a Telegram bot token, and Docker linux/arm64 build support. The entire system is contained in a single AWS CloudFormation template, deploys with one command, and runs on consumption-based pricing costing a few dollars a month for light personal use.

news.title: Responsible AI governance: How AWS positions customers to align with ISO/IEC 42005:2025
news.summary: AWS outlines how customers can align AI governance with ISO/IEC 42005:2025, covering AI system impact assessments and integration into existing enterprise risk management, including Annex D for simplifying assessments and Annex E for a standalone template. The post cites global AI-related investment in 2025 of $581.69 billion and notes AWS ISO certifications for Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q Business, Amazon Transcribe, and Amazon Textract, along with an ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AIMS implementation guide and the Well-Architected Framework Responsible AI Lens.

news.title: Best practices for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod administration and governance
news.summary: AWS describes administering Amazon SageMaker HyperPod through SageMaker Unified Studio while preserving governance controls across four layers: organization, project, cluster, and workload. Controls cited include SageMaker Unified Studio domains and project profiles at the organization layer, project membership and HyperPod connections, cluster admin roles with Amazon EKS access entries and RBAC or Slurm, and workload-level compute allocations, priority classes, and lending and borrowing policies.

news.title: Manage Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Spaces directly from SageMaker Studio
news.summary: AWS introduced the ability to create and manage SageMaker Spaces on SageMaker HyperPod EKS clusters directly from the SageMaker Studio UI, via a new IDE and Notebooks tab, so users can launch JupyterLab and Code Editor environments without command-line tools. Administrators install the Spaces add-on using Quick install or Custom install (required for web UI access), create Space templates, and configure access with EKS access entries using managed policies such as AmazonSagemakerHyperpodSpacePolicy.

highlights.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
highlights.authors: Xin Wang, Hao Yu, Zhengyang Zhuge et al.
highlights.why: TRACE 对 MoE 模型的 FP4 RL 使用 rollout 引导的量化，在获得实际效率提升的同时直接减少了训练与 rollout 之间的差异。
highlights.key_result: 我们在四个大规模 MoE 语言模型上评估了 TRACE，覆盖推理、编码和长程 RL 任务。我们的结果表明，TRACE 能够实现联合 FP4 权重/激活和 FP4 KV-cache rollout，其 RL 性能与 BF16 rollout 相当，同时相比对 BF16 训练策略进行事后 FP4 量化，实现了高达 5.4 的 rollout 加速和强大的最终 FP4 性能。
evidence: We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4 rollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

highlights.title: From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail
highlights.authors: Hongzhan Lin, Shidong Cao, Ziyang Luo et al.
highlights.why: 通过实证确定了使用工具的智能体在证据与行动之间失败的环节，并提供了一个基准和确定性评估器。
highlights.key_result: 在十个模型-测试框架配置中，较强的静态动作评估可能与弱得多的交互式执行同时存在：失败往往在执行之前就已开始，智能体在不完整调查后停止，或在所需证据尚未建立时就采取行动；而一旦获得所需证据，单动作执行通常是可靠的，多动作工作流还会额外暴露未解决的先决条件和执行不完整的问题。
evidence: Across ten model--harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution.
GLM--ZCode and DeepSeek--DSH both exceed 96% on Legacy, yet they differ sharply on V1--V3: DeepSeek--DSH remains around 60%, whereas GLM--ZCode falls to between 12.1% and 34.1%.

Conditional on an action attempt after evidence completion, CAS ranges from 93.2% to 100% for nine of the ten configurations, with DeepSeek--Inspect lower at 83.3%. Investigation and action timing are therefore important upstream sources of failure, whereas single-action execution after evidence completion remains generally reliable.

highlights.title: DecepEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Deception in LLM Agents
highlights.authors: Yiming Xu, Hongyue Yu, Beihua Yang et al.
highlights.why: 引入了针对 LLM 智能体在不同条件下欺骗行为的系统化基准，揭示了即使在基线较低的模型中，诱导也会增加欺骗行为。
highlights.key_result: 本文介绍了 DecepEval，一个包含 3 个任务族和 28 个专业场景的基准，共 1,532 个实例；并报告了对九个前沿 LLM 的评估显示，诱导会增加所有被评估模型和任务族中的欺骗行为，其中长程交互表现出最高比例，增加了 55.73%。
evidence: To address this gap, we introduce DecepEval, a benchmark comprising 1,532 instances across 3 task families and 28 professional scenarios. Drawing on classical fraud theories, we propose the LLM Deception Diamond framework, which characterizes four external conditions that may induce deception: pressure, incentive, opportunity, and conflict.

Evaluations of nine frontier LLMs show that inducements increase deception across models and task families, even among models with low baseline deception rates. DecepEval makes these vulnerabilities measurable, providing a shared benchmark for progress toward trustworthy artificial intelligence.

Inducements increase deception across all evaluated models and task families, with long-horizon interactions exhibiting the highest rates, increasing by 55.73%. Under induced conditions, deception is more prevalent in medical, legal, and financial scenarios and less frequent in software engineering tasks with executable checks.

highlights.title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
highlights.authors: Yifan Zhang, Jichen Feng, Shihan Qin
highlights.why: Recurrent Looped Transformer 引入循环解码器以实现长度泛化，在算法任务上展现出显著提升。
highlights.key_result: Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance; on swap-based S_5 permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth; on modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based S_5 to chance at every split.

On swap-based S_5 permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based S_5 to chance at every split.

highlights.title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
highlights.authors: Edan Kinderman, Elad Hoffer, Yochai Blau et al.
highlights.why: 表明单一模型内部机制即可在检索和长上下文场景中选择证据，并带来显著提升和极少参数。
highlights.key_result: UNREAL 是一个模型原生的证据选择框架，新增不到 500K 个可训练参数且不改变骨干网络，让所有四个稠密和混合 UNREAL 骨干在 3B token、21M 块的 Wikipedia 索引上超越了最先进的检索器-重排器系统：最佳模型在 HotpotQA 上将召回率从 49.1% 提升到 73.2%，在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上从 31.7% 提升到 60.1%，在 MuSiQue 上从 8.8% 提升到 14.4%；而在长上下文任务中，同一机制将 NoLiMa 准确率在 128K token 下从 1.0% 提升到 24.83%，将 LV-Eval 的 F1 分数在 256K 下从 49.97% 提升到 54.66%。
evidence: We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue.

Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mechanism removes distractors before generation, raising NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at its maximum context length of 128K tokens, and LV-Eval’s F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K. UNREAL also reduces FLOPs and time-to-first-token relative to full-context inference from roughly 32K tokens onward, with larger gains as context grows. Together, these results establish model-internal evidence selection as a common foundation for corpus retrieval and evidence-sparse long-context inference.

highlights.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
highlights.authors: Sarim Hashmi, Mukul Ranjan, Kshitij Mishra et al.
highlights.theme: GUI and Web Agents for Computer Use
highlights.why: 在 Web 世界模型中共同演化课程、对手和智能体，提高对未见自适应提示注入的鲁棒性。
highlights.key_result: 在 150 个 Web 任务上，AdvSim2Real 将未见对手 Kimi-K3 下的完成率相对基础智能体提升了 33.6%，并将干净完成率从 74.89% 提升到 81.33%，将三个已学习对手下的完成率从 48.07% 提升到 57.48%。
evidence: On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6% relative to the base agent.

AdvSim2Real raises clean completion from 74.89% to 81.33% and completion under the three learned adversaries from 48.07% to 57.48% ( tab:wm-results). Against Kimi-K3, a frontier model that took no part in training, completion rises from 23.00% to 30.72%, a 33.6% relative gain ( tab:frontier-adversary).

On 150 web tasks, clean completion rises from 74.89% to 81.33% and completion under three learned adversaries from 48.07% to 57.48%, matching a hosted 9B model, and completion under the unseen Kimi-K3 rises by 33.6% relative to the base agent.

highlights.title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
highlights.authors: Antoine Edy, Max Conti, Victor Xing et al.
highlights.why: DAEDALUS 从自生成任务中引导可复用的智能体记忆，无需预言机，从而提升多个基准上的成功率。
highlights.key_result: 在 AppWorld、τ²-bench 和 AutomationBench 上，Daedalus 相较于无记忆基线将平均成功率提高多达 15.9 个百分点，将 pass@5 提高多达 2.2，并且在与使用训练任务的方法相比时具有竞争力，同时推理成本低于大多数方法。
evidence: Across AppWorld, ^2-bench, and AutomationBench, Daedalus improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 percentage points and pass 5 by up to 2.2 over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most.
On AppWorld , ^2-bench , and AutomationBench , Daedalus improves success rates by up to 15.9 points over a no-memory baseline and raises pass 5 by 1.7 to 2.2 , at little to no extra inference cost.

Daedalus raises the MSR of the base agent by 15.9, 10.0 and 4.3 points over the no-memory baseline on AppWorld, ^2-bench and AutomationBench (Table ). pass 5 increases by 1.7 to 2.2 , indicating that the method also improves consistency across runs.

news.summary: NVIDIA 将 DOCA GPUNetIO 描述为统一的 GDA-KI 基础，允许 CUDA 内核驱动以太网、RDMA、Verbs 和 DMA 操作，使 CPU 脱离关键路径，既作为 DOCA SDK 超集发布，也提供更轻量的开源 Verbs 实现。NVIDIA 报告称 NCCL GIN 自 2.27 版本起集成开源 GPUNetIO Verbs 路径，NVSHMEM 3.7 添加了基于 GPUNetIO 的传输，NVQLink 在配备 Blackwell GPU 和 ConnectX-7 的 IGX Thor 上实现了约 2.6 微秒的最低往返延迟。

news.title: AICR v1.0: Open, stable, and verifiable GPU cluster configuration
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 AICR v1.0，为 GPU 加速的 Kubernetes 集群提供版本锁定且经过验证的配方，并在 CLI、REST API、Go SDK、bundle 布局和构件模式之间建立稳定的兼容性契约。其四项能力为 Snapshot、Recipe、Bundle 和 Validation；AICR 拥有超过 100 位不同贡献者，其中近一半来自 NVIDIA 之外，并集成了 Pulumi Labs 和 Mirantis 的 k0rdent。

news.title: Control How Your GPU Shares Work with Green Contexts
news.summary: CUDA 13.1 中的 Green contexts 允许应用在单个进程内显式划分 GPU 执行资源，例如 SM 和工作队列，继其自 CUDA 12.4 起在 Driver API 中可用之后。NVIDIA 报告了一个示例，在具有 148 个 SM 的 Blackwell GPU 上将关键内核延迟从 0.140 ms 降低到 0.007 ms；该功能是选择性启用且可叠加的。

news.title: Building a context-aware AI assistant on AgentCore and OpenClaw
news.summary: AWS 描述了在 AgentCore 运行时上构建一个名为 Sprout 的上下文感知园艺助手，使用开源智能体系统 OpenClaw 和 AgentCore 记忆，其中 Claude Haiku 4.5 用于文本，Claude Sonnet 4.5 用于视觉，并使用 Telegram bot token 以及 Docker linux/arm64 构建支持。整个系统包含在一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板中，一条命令即可部署，并以按量定价运行，轻度个人使用每月仅需几美元。

news.title: Responsible AI governance: How AWS positions customers to align with ISO/IEC 42005:2025
news.summary: AWS 概述了客户如何使 AI 治理与 ISO/IEC 42005:2025 对齐，涵盖 AI 系统影响评估以及整合到现有企业风险管理中，包括用于简化评估的附录 D 和用于独立模板的附录 E。文章引用 2025 年全球 AI 相关投资为 581.69 十亿美元，并指出 AWS 已获得 Amazon Bedrock、Amazon Q Business、Amazon Transcribe 和 Amazon Textract 的 ISO 认证，同时提供 ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AIMS 实施指南和 Well-Architected Framework Responsible AI Lens。

news.title: Best practices for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod administration and governance
news.summary: AWS 描述了通过 SageMaker Unified Studio 管理 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod，同时在四个层级上保留治理控制：组织、项目、集群和工作负载。所述控制包括组织层的 SageMaker Unified Studio 域和项目配置文件、项目成员资格与 HyperPod 连接、具有 Amazon EKS 访问条目和 RBAC 或 Slurm 的集群管理员角色，以及工作负载级的计算分配、优先级类别和借用策略。

news.title: Manage Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Spaces directly from SageMaker Studio
news.summary: AWS 推出了直接从 SageMaker Studio UI 在 SageMaker HyperPod EKS 集群上创建和管理 SageMaker Spaces 的能力，通过新的 IDE 和 Notebooks 选项卡，用户无需命令行工具即可启动 JupyterLab 和 Code Editor 环境。管理员使用 Quick install 或 Custom install（Web UI 访问所需）安装 Spaces 附加组件，创建 Space 模板，并使用 AmazonSagemakerHyperpodSpacePolicy 等托管策略通过 EKS 访问条目配置访问权限。
